editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood institution where owner John and his welcoming staff serve generous, excellent Italian-American fare that keeps guests coming back for decades.
editorial.insiderTip: Book Vazzy's for your next catering event—Kristen expertly guides you through portion sizes and timing, and their reliability for on-time delivery and budget-friendly pricing is legendary.

topDishes.note: So generously sized it feeds four lunches
